attribution: Ratul, Rezaur Rahman; Moni, Kona; Das, Aranya Kishor; Sowdagor, Aditya; Ahmmed, Suman; Huda, Mohammad Nurul; and Ohidujjaman (2026), “WasteSegCluster: dataset of annotated waste images from urban water bodies in Bangladesh,” Mendeley Data v4, DOI: 10.17632/3wnf3n242s.4, CC BY 4.0.
label_format: YOLO normalized axis-aligned bounding boxes derived from source COCO bbox annotations; annotations.jsonl records boxes
transform: cvlesson-0.1.0: source JPEG pixels unchanged; COCO boxes normalized; empty parent category omitted; source train/valid/test split retained
student_use_case: 水辺に見えるごみを検出して清掃場所の確認・活動計画を補助する
limitations: Collected around Dhaka, Bangladesh. The package provides bounding boxes although source includes polygons. One image has no source annotations; empty labels mean no boxes supplied, not a confirmed clean scene. Not a measure of water quality or health risk. 50 images visually sampled.

transformation.output_format: normalized YOLO bbox; source COCO bbox values preserved through normalization

inner_manifest.visual_review: 50 images sampled across the fixed archive. Waste is visible in waterway and bank scenes; no identifiable people were observed in the sample.
